chapter: Los Angeles with Mutt Carey and the taxi dances
title: Did the bands change their styles over the years
summary: Joe says Mutt, Ram and Ory played about the same in the late Twenties as later, with small halls using five pieces.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: In later years you played with Mutt and Ram, and naturally with Ory. Would you say their styles changed any? Did they play any different in the late Twenties, when you worked with them, until now?
About the same. Most of those bands played about the same, and most of them used... Some of the little smaller dance halls would use like five pieces maybe, just one saxophone and the trumpet.
